lead.en: Describe collections and relationships precisely. Learn which grouping rules produce genuine equivalence classes, which dependency rules form orders, and when a mapping can be reversed.
lead.zh: 精确描述集合及其关系。学习哪些分组规则产生真正的等价类，哪些依赖规则构成序，以及映射何时能够逆转。

prerequisites.en: Modules 01–02: domains, functions, logical connectives, quantifiers, and counterexamples. Explain the negation of a universal rule before beginning. Labs use Python's standard library.
prerequisites.zh: 模块 01–02：定义域、函数、逻辑联结词、量词与反例。开始前解释全称规则的否定。实验只用 Python 标准库。

en: Compute set operations relative to a declared universe and form power sets and Cartesian products.
Prove a set identity by following the membership of an arbitrary element.
Classify relations using explicit pairs and triples that witness failed properties.
Construct equivalence classes and explain why they form a partition.
Distinguish partial orders from equivalences and test injectivity and surjectivity with the declared codomain.
zh: 在明确全集中计算集合运算，并构造幂集与笛卡尔积。
用任意元素的成员关系证明集合恒等式。
通过违反性质的具体配对与三元组分类关系。
构造等价类并解释它们为何形成划分。
区分偏序与等价，依据明确陪域检验单射与满射。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and expand the membership arguments.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节并展开成员论证。

text.en: Predict and run the set-identity enumeration.
text.zh: 预测并运行集合恒等式枚举。

text.en: Retrieve membership, inclusion, and the universe convention.
text.zh: 回忆属于、包含与全集约定。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and inspect counterexample triples.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节并检查反例三元组。

text.en: Run the relation classifier and use the explorer.
text.zh: 运行关系分类器并使用探索器。

text.en: Prove the membership identity in Exercise 5.
text.zh: 证明练习 5 的成员恒等式。

text.en: Read the assigned sets and relation definitions.
text.zh: 阅读指定的集合与关系定义。

text.en: Read Section 5 and draw the inclusion order.
text.zh: 阅读第 5 节并画包含序。

text.en: Read equivalence and partial orders; compare their axioms.
text.zh: 阅读等价与偏序，比较公理。

text.en: Explain antisymmetry and transitivity from memory.
text.zh: 凭记忆解释反对称与传递。

text.en: Read Section 6 and the failure analysis.
text.zh: 阅读第 6 节与故障分析。

text.en: Run Lab 3 and explain order-dependent grouping.
text.zh: 运行实验 3并解释依赖顺序的分组。

text.en: Complete choices, written explanation, and exit assessment.
text.zh: 完成选择题、书面解释与结业评估。
